title: Walking in Divine Favor
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he teaches on the topic of "Walking in Divine Favor" in this powerful sermon. Pastor Zehner explains that divine favor is not something we can earn, but rather a gift from God that comes from the blood of Jesus, and he shows us how to tap into this favor in our daily lives. Whether you're feeling stuck or struggling to see God's blessings in your life, this message is a must-listen for anyone seeking to walk in a greater level of favor and blessing in 2026.
